title: FairLRF: Achieving Fairness through Sparse Low Rank Factorization
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness in deep learning models for image classification (specifically VGG-11 on datasets like CelebA and Fitzpatrick-17k). It addresses demographic bias through singular value decomposition (SVD) and matrix factorization. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
